Рад, что ты с нами, командир. Поринги на:
Glad to have you with us, Commander. The Porings in the South Fields have gone wild, and we need every blade.

Come by the camp every day: logging in earns rewards, and for the first seven days there are rookie quests too. Both end with “Hero Contracts”: a Purple hero of your choice.

Attached is a little something to get you started.
Мир Рун-Мидгарда изменился: The World of Rune-Midgard Has Changed
Командир, пока ты отдыхал, летописцы пер:
Commander, while you rested, the chroniclers rewrote our road. Beneath Prontera there are no swamps, but culverts where Morroc's thieves hide their crates. Past Geffen, the orcs are waiting. To the north lies Al De Baran and its Clock Tower. Chapters 2, 3 and 7 have been retold: check the Chronicle, it's all written down.

Glast Heim and Niflheim haven't gone anywhere — they're further down the road, as chapters 8 and 10. Everything you've cleared stays yours. When you reach the gates of Glast Heim, we'll meet there.
Командир, летописцы нашли пропущенную ст:
Commander, the chroniclers found a missing page. Between Glast Heim and Niflheim, the squad passed through Labyrinth Forest — to Baphomet, who keeps the consent of the living. You've already cleared this chapter, the ninth: it all counts.

But you never saw what happened there. Check the Chronicle — it holds the scenes, the finds and the name of the one who signed the contract.
Командир, луга снова пахнут травой, а не:
Commander, the fields smell of grass again, not Porings. Bruno cried into his apron and poured a round on the house — Bran noted it's the first time in twenty years.

I saw the little bell. I know the mark on it, and I don't like it. The Grey One's trail leads under the cobblestones — and by royal decree, rookies are cleaning the sewers right now. Take lamps and tall boots.

Attached: for the lamps and boots.
Уважаемый командир!\n\nСлужба Кафра благ:
Dear Commander!

Kafra Services thanks your squad for clearing the sewers: the warehouses under the South Gate are dry again, and the bugs no longer carry off our clients' parcels piece by piece.

During the inventory, our clerk found an empty sand crate marked “Geffen, westward.” We return it to you — it seems you need it more.

Sincerely, Kafra Services. We're always nearby!
Командиру отряда из Пронтеры.\n\nАрхив Г:
To the commander of the squad from Prontera.

The Geffen Tower Archive has received copies of the Orc Village rites. The note “forty years off the roads” is confirmed: the orcs kept the chieftains' oath until someone broke it. Who and why — our books hold no answer.

We ask: if you meet more of these horned marks, sketch them. The Tower will pay for paper and ink.
Командир, гонец из Моррока загнал второг:
Commander, the courier from Morroc rode a second horse into the ground — this time with good news. The pyramid sleeps, the mummies lie still, the city above the seal stands.

Bran sent a sketch of a fresco: the gods lay the horned one beneath the sands and build a city on top. “Knot,” “seal,” “guardians” — I've heard those words before, and not from priests.

Osiris spoke of a fox in the east. That's Payon. Rest a day — then set out.
